'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Mitch Wieland DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Wieland]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
